# ui::KeyFrame

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

One key frame: a value at a time (milliseconds from the animation's start). Build one with the named factories, so [`kind`](#kind) and `easing` agree.

Example: 
```cpp
const std::vector<ui::KeyFrame> frames{
    ui::KeyFrame::linear(0ms, 0.0f),
    ui::KeyFrame::eased(300ms, 1.0f, ui::CubicEase{}),
    ui::KeyFrame::discrete(600ms, 0.5f),
    ui::KeyFrame::spline(900ms, 1.0f, ui::CubicBezier{0.8f, 0.0f, 0.2f, 1.0f}),
};
auto element = std::make_unique<ui::RectangleControl>();
element->start_animation(ui::AnimatedProperty::Opacity, ui::KeyFrameAnimation{.key_frames = frames});
```

## time

```cpp
Duration time {}
```

[Key](../core/namespace-ui.md#key) time from the animation's start.

## value

```cpp
float value = 0.0f
```

The value reached at [`time`](#time).

## kind

```cpp
KeyFrameKind kind = KeyFrameKind::Linear
```

How the segment ending at this frame interpolates.

## easing

```cpp
EasingFunction easing {}
```

The segment's curve for Spline (a [CubicBezier](../rendering/cubic-bezier.md)) and Easing; ignored otherwise.

## linear

```cpp
static KeyFrame linear(Duration time, float value)
```

Interpolates linearly from the previous value.

## discrete

```cpp
static KeyFrame discrete(Duration time, float value)
```

Holds the previous value, then jumps to [`value`](#value) at [`time`](#time).

## spline

```cpp
static KeyFrame spline(Duration time, float value, CubicBezier spline)
```

Interpolates along the cubic Bézier [`spline`](#spline).

## eased

```cpp
static KeyFrame eased(Duration time, float value, EasingFunction easing)
```

Interpolates along `easing`.
